newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land sets 25 pct stock, three ctv cash div.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land sets 25 pct stock, three ctv cash div.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc declared on Tuesday a 25 percent stock dividend and a three centavo per share cash dividend.
In its disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE), the property firm said the stock dividend will apply to stockholders as of May 8, 1997.
The record date for the cash dividend is April 7, the company said.
The cash dividend will be payable on May 20 while stock dividend on June 18.
The company said the ex-cash date is set on March 25 while the ex-stock date is slated for April 28.
The PSE research department said that in 1996, Ayala Land declared a 50 percent stock dividend.
It had also announced two cash dividends of three centavos each. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
